text:
Noah: Quick live follow-up from todays all-hands — use this thread for short questions about pipeline, GTM priorities, and partner asks. Keep it tight.
Emma: Heads-up: were moving to a tiered partner qualification next quarter (Gold/Silver) to prioritize co-sell resources. Gold requires ARR >250k or proof of channel access.
Ravi: Clarify: is ARR strictly new ARR, or can we count expansion? @Emma
Emma: New ARR preferred, but qualified expansions that clearly accelerate net-new pipeline can count with RevOps approval.
Priya: Partnership ops: Gold partners get 4 co-sell hours + MDF eligibility; Silver gets enablement resources only. I'll post the checklist and scoring rubric.
Marco: Sales question: will we spotlight partner-influenced opps in the weekly forecast? We need a filter to avoid double-counting.
Ethan (Ops): we'll add a partner flag in SFDC and a separate forecast bucket. Finance asked for partner-verified evidence before counting credit.
Lina: Product note: the partner onboarding SDK for private deployments is delayed two sprints; that affects mid-market playbooks.
Ezra: CS ask: what are SLAs for Gold partner deals for onboarding and support? Need to update runbooks.
Priya: Baseline onboarding SLA 30 days. Gold partners can request a bumped SLA of 14 days if they commit to the joint-POV checklist and a named PoC.
Ravi: Actionable: Sales to tag current open opps that are partner-influenced with `partner-flag` by COB Thu. RevOps will run a validation pass.
Noah: Can someone drop a short 1-pager with Gold/Silver criteria, incentives, and the SFDC tagging steps here by tomorrow?
Priya: I'll upload the 1-pager + scoring sheet in this thread by 10am tomorrow and schedule a 30-min Q&A next week.
Emma: Exec ask: escalate any deals needing leadership buy-in by Friday into #sales-escalations and DM me. Well triage live.
deploy-bot: Recording + notes: https://redwood.internal/all-hands/1939993211
Marco: thanks — will start tagging opps and sync with RevOps.
Lina: will update playbook sections affected by the SDK delay and post diffs in #product-docs.
Noah: Perfect. Keep updates short. If you hit blockers, tag @Emma or @Priya.
